title: Scanning a nested pair encoding
statement: For any two finite bit strings $\alpha$ and $w$, scan the encoding $\langle\alpha,w\rangle$ from the left in consecutive pairs, retaining each pair until the first unequal pair, which is retained before the scan stops. Appending $\langle\alpha,w\rangle$ to the resulting string gives $\langle\alpha,\langle\alpha,w\rangle\rangle$.
